articles.summary: The Bundesliga landed on free streaming in the US and a brand new women's baseball league debuted on ESPN, both within a fortnight. Carriage is no longer the bottleneck in sports media. Content throughput is.
articles.title: Two Rights Deals in Two Weeks, and the Map Keeps Splitting

articles.summary: FIFA reported 30 billion impressions and 14.5 billion video views across TikTok and YouTube during the 2026 World Cup. Video views grew 485% over 2022 while impressions grew 130%. That gap is the whole story.
articles.title: The 2026 World Cup Was Won on Short Form Video
